text_block_list.text:
One day, after reaching a milestone. I 
went to a hot spring using the special 
lottery prize I won before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Our inn's hot spring is a "simple thermal 
spring"— meaning it is effective for 
general indications such as neuralgia, 
muscle pain, and health promotion.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In addition, a total of nine types of 
relaxation facilities are available, 
including massage and aroma therapy 
salons.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's dinner is a multi-course kaiseki 
meal made with seasonal ingredients. The 
centerpiece will be our specially selected 
teppanyaki Wagyu beef.
choice_data_list: You really did a lot of research for this.

You really looked into this for me, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is a trip to express my "gratitude" 
to Master—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the mission for this trip 
is to increase Master's satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Prior knowledge is, of course, essential. 
Well then, off you go.

"Well, let's hit the hot springs first," I 
say, heading for the door— but Mihono 
Bourbon shows no sign of moving from that 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes. It is unnecessary for me to take 
a bath on this trip.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"If an error occurs, please contact me at 
any time. I will handle it."
choice_data_list: Let's kick back and relax too, Bourbon

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Unforeseen situation detected. However, 
if it is Master's order... um...

"Because the two of us have worked so hard 
together." When I added that...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Order received. Executing 'unwinding.'
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rise in body temperature, mind and body 
loosening... Status "Relaxed" confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In other words... "the bath was lovely."

There was still some time before dinner. 
To cool off after the hot springs, I 
invited her for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Letting one's hair down" really is 
"pleasant", Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If it were not for Master's proposal, I 
would never have experienced such a 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“...... No, allow me to correct myself. 
This is something that could not have been 
built on today's proposal alone.”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Spending these past few years alongside 
Master, I have experienced 'fun,' 'joy,' 
and 'frustration' in great abundance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that is precisely why I've 
become able to immediately tune into every 
sensation."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If it were the me of before— I likely 
would have brushed it off without even 
noticing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Soaking in the hot springs, surrounded by 
the scent of mineral water while gazing at 
the scenery... 'Comfortable'..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Cooling off in the night breeze with 
Master after a bath... 'Fun,' 'happy'—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have understood... such a 
gentle, rare sensation like this.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am certain this is all thanks to you, 
Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Most likely— though it's hard to put 
into words...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When I am by Master's side... my emotions 
are prone to fluctuation.

As she speaks, Mihono Bourbon's expression 
is noticeably softer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm... truly "glad" to have met you, 
Master.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Mihono Bourbon...
